title: Sherman's base photo identified as San Vito dei Normanni
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Sherman's base photo identified as San Vito dei Normanni, about 1990s at San Vito dei Normanni, Italy, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: And then what's wild is the base he was at. He took a photo of it and it's in above black. And I, you know, we we reversed, me and my researcher reverse image searched it and we figured out it was San Vito de Normandy

plain: A podcast host named Jesse Michels says that a man named Dan Sherman included a photo of the base where he worked in his book Above Black. Michels says he and his researcher ran the photo through a reverse image search and found it was San Vito dei Normanni, a base in southern Italy, from the 1990s. He tells it as a way of checking where Sherman's story took place.
